response.sql: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) as avg_value FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL), station_avgs AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) as avg_value FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation) SELECT AVG(t.bandusagepct) as mean_bandwidth_usage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) - (SELECT avg_value FROM overall_avg) as above_average FROM telescopes t WHERE t.observstation IN (SELECT observstation FROM station_avgs WHERE avg_value > (SELECT avg_value FROM overall_avg)) AND t.bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
